column1: Notes & items to confirm before publishing

1. Placeholders: HTML comments (<!-- ... -->) mark where to add real photos, customer reviews, the contact form, phone number, address and hours. No reviews, years in business, licenses or prices were invented.

2. Service areas: city pages assume Brook Concrete Company genuinely serves Sandy Springs, Brookhaven, Chamblee, Doraville, Peachtree Corners, Norcross, Roswell and Johns Creek. Remove any city you do not serve.

3. URL structure: service pages use root-level slugs (e.g. /concrete-driveways/) as in the core service table of your plan. If you prefer the nested /services/ structure, update slugs and internal links together.

4. Each page has exactly 1 H1, 3 internal anchors (all distinct, all present in the content) and 1 external anchor (opens in a new tab). External links point to concrete.org, cement.org, ascconline.org and city government sites; please verify they load before launch.
5. SEO titles are 60 characters or fewer; meta descriptions are 160 characters or fewer.
6. Blog posts avoid specific dollar figures since costs vary; add local pricing ranges only if you can back them up.
7. Pages added beyond your core list: Concrete Services hub, Service Areas hub, 2 extra blog posts (slab thickness, preventing cracks) so internal links resolve.
8. Contact details: Confirmed company phone number is +1 (770) 764-2908 and business address is 1936 Cotillion Dr, Dunwoody, GA 30338, United States (updated in Contact Us page).
